notes: As drawn (docs/turret-wiring.md 3.3: ARM through 6.8 k into 1 uF and one 74HCT14 inverter on the cartridge board) BRAKE rises 6.8 ms x ln(3.3 / V_T-) = 5-14 ms (about 8) after ARM falls; D3 and 1 k fill the capacitor (tau 0.9 ms) when ARM rises, so BRAKE falls 0.6-1.4 ms later, long before the ESCs can drive.
